⚠️ Sorry, I couldn't understand the voice message. Please try again or send your request as text.

Supported queries:
🎣 "Is it good to fish here?"
🌊 "How is the sea?"
📍 "Where should I fish?"

🎣 *OCEAN SENTRY — FISHERMAN ASSISTANT*

Hello {{ $json.first_name }}! I can help you with ocean intelligence.

*Commands:*
📍 Share Location — Get fishing intelligence
🎣 /fish — Fishing suitability
🌊 /sea — Sea conditions
📌 /zone — Recommended fishing zone
🚨 /alerts — Coastal alerts
🔔 /subscribe — Subscribe to alerts
🔕 /unsubscribe — Stop alerts
🎙 Voice message — Ask anything

*How it works:*
1️⃣ Share your GPS location
2️⃣ Ask questions about fishing or sea
3️⃣ I'll use real ocean data to advise

_Data: Copernicus Marine + Argo observations_
_ML: Isolation Forest anomaly detection_

📍 I don't have your location yet.

Please share your Telegram location first:
Tap 📎 → Location → Send current location

Then ask me again!

🔔 *Subscribed to Ocean Sentry Alerts!*

You will receive notifications when:
⚠️ Ocean anomalies are detected
🌊 Sea conditions change significantly
🟢 Favorable fishing conditions appear

Alerts checked every 6 hours.

Reply /unsubscribe to stop.

📍 Please share your location first before subscribing to alerts.

Tap 📎 → Location → Send current location
Then send /subscribe again.

🔕 *Unsubscribed.*

You will no longer receive Ocean Sentry alerts.

Send /subscribe to re-enable.
